Name: Weather Wonders - Stable
Author: Kanadeyoru
Description:
[center][url=https://ibb.co/RchpnVS][/url][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/bXHgh83/TITULO-WEATHER-WONDERS-MAIOR.png[/img][/center]
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/zuQC9Di.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/ezVo9Fb.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/wpd1ojJ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/cXhDLc5.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/4TuCTyd.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Rx3ITqh.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/BMA0w39.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Jvsm5YJ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/sCGo8Hh.png[/img][/center]





[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ssxbrDn/about.png[/img][/center]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][i]'Feel The Nature'
[/i]
Weather Wonders was created for those who want to make their game feel more alive and dynamic by adding greater diversity to the in-game weather system. Currently, it introduces numerous new weather types, lunar events, nightly events and much more are yet to come!

All of these have been designed with the intention of blending seamlessly with the vanilla style. [b][u][i]The mod is fully configurable! - You can disable/enable anything you want.[/i][/u][/b][/size]



[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/VThqBFd/features.png[/img][/center]
[size=4][b]✦ New weather types:[/b][/size]
[size=4] [color=#efefef]➔ Blizzard.[/color] [/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=3](winter)[/size][/color]
[size=4] [color=#efefef]➔ Deluge.[/color] [/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=3](spring, summer, and fall)[/size][/color]
[size=4] [color=#efefef]➔ Drizzle.[/color] [/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=3](spring, summer, and fall)[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#efefef] ➔ Dry Lightning.[/color] [/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=3](spring, summer, fall, and winter)[/size][/color]
[color=#efefef][size=4] ➔ Hailstorm. [/size][/color][color=#d8d8d8][size=3](summer, fall)[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#efefef] ➔ Mist.[/color] [/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=3](spring, fall)[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#efefef] ➔ Rain-Snow Mix.[/color] [/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=3](early spring, late fall, and winter)[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#efefef] ➔ Heatwaves.[/color] [/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=3](late spring and summer)[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#efefef] ➔ Muddy Rain.[/color] [/size][size=3](spring and summer)[/size]
[size=4] ➔ Cloudy.[/size][size=4] [/size][size=3](spring and fall)[/size]
[size=4] ➔ Acid Rain.[color=#d8d8d8] [/color][/size][size=3](spring and summer)[/size]

[size=4][b]✦ New lunar events:[/b][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4] ➔ Blood moon.[/size]
[size=4] ➔ Harvest moon.[/size]
[/color][size=4][color=#efefef] ➔ Blue moon.[/color]
[/size]
[size=4][b]✦ New nightly events:[/b][/size]
[size=4][color=#efefef] ➔ Earthquake[/color]
[/size]
[size=4][b]✦ Custom buffs.
✦ Custom sounds and music.
✦ Unique Weather Report episodes.
✦ Unique moon clock icons.
✦ Visual wind.
✦ Alternate snow visuals[/b][/size]



[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/Gt5WgTd/plans.png[/img][/center]
[size=4][b]✦ New weather types such as:[/b][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4] ➔ Sandstorm.
 ➔ Showers.
 ➔ Frozen Rain.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]✦ Lunar events such as:[/b][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4] ➔ Eclipse.
 ➔ Supermoon[/size][/color]

[b][size=4]✦ Nightly events (still gathering ideas).[/size][/b]
[color=#efefef][size=4] ➔ Joja Shipwreck.
[/size][/color][size=4] ➔ Gale.
[/size][size=4] ➔ Waterspout.[/size]


[b][size=4]✦ Add more side effects for all the new weather types. [/size][/b][/font]



[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/PNXT5Js/faq.png[/img][/center][size=4][b][quote]Is this compatible with [insert mod name here]?[/quote][/b][color=#efefef][font=Trebuchet MS] - Yes, Weather Wonders should be compatible with any mod.[/font]
[/color]
[/size][quote][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b]Does this work with multiplayer?[/b][/size][/font][/quote][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][color=#efefef]- Yes.
[/color][/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]
[quote][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b]Do I need to install both beta and stable versions?[/b][/size][/font][/quote][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][color=#efefef]- No, choose and install only one of them.[/color][/size][/font]

[/size][/font][quote][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]Can you add [insert suggestion here] configuration option?[/size][/font][/b][/quote][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][color=#efefef]- Almost every aspect of the mod is configurable; before requesting more configuration options, make sure to check if your suggestion isn't already implemented.[/color]

[/size][/font][quote][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]How do these new weathers affect events?[/size][/font][/b][/quote][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]- I really wanted to create specific schedules for the NPCs based on the weather, but for the sake of modding compatibility, the NPCs schedules will be according to the vanilla weather:
[/size][/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Rain-Snow Mix > Rain[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Deluge > Storm[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Hailstorm > Rain[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Drizzle > Rain[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Dry Lightning > Sunny[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Mist > Sunny[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Blizzard > Snow[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Heatwaves > Sunny[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Muddy Rain > Rain[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Cloudy > Sunny[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]Acid Rain > Rain[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]
[/size][/font][quote][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]If I install this does the chance of a rain increase?[/size][/font][/b][/quote][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef][size=4]- No.[/size][/color]

Adds areas from SVE to Blood Moon's monster spawn regions.
